name: private-ai-gateway-pi-providers
description: Vendor-neutral Pi provider for private-ai-gateway (ACI) + thin branded distributions (redpill, phala-cloud)

scripts.clean: npm run clean -w @phala/pi-provider-aci && npm run clean -w pi-provider-redpill && npm run clean -w pi-provider-phala-cloud
scripts.build: npm run build -w @phala/pi-provider-aci && npm run build -w pi-provider-redpill && npm run build -w pi-provider-phala-cloud
scripts.lint:packages: npm run build && publint packages/pi-provider-aci && publint packages/pi-provider-redpill && publint packages/pi-provider-phala-cloud && attw --pack --profile esm-only packages/pi-provider-aci && attw --pack --profile esm-only packages/pi-provider-redpill && attw --pack --profile esm-only packages/pi-provider-phala-cloud
scripts.pack:check: npm run pack:check -w @phala/pi-provider-aci && npm run pack:check -w pi-provider-redpill && npm run pack:check -w pi-provider-phala-cloud
